title: AgentConfig
description: Schema for OpenCode agent definition files (YAML frontmatter in .opencode/agents/*.md). Defines agent role, permissions, and execution limits.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this agent does.

mode.description: Agent mode. 'primary' = direct interaction, 'subagent' = invoked by primary.

steps.description: Maximum number of tool calls per invocation. If omitted, no cap.

edit.description: Whether the agent can modify files.

oneOf.description: Simple allow/deny for all bash commands.
Pattern-based bash rules. Key '*' is the default. Specific command patterns override the default.

bash.description: Bash command permissions. Can be a simple allow/deny string or an object with pattern-based rules.

webfetch.description: Whether the agent can fetch URLs.

external_directory.description: Whether the agent can access directories outside the project.
